FOREIGN COLORS | MLS PLAYBOOK
Research-informed application, not a proven outcome.

TITLE: Do not ask fans to surrender their other scarf.

IDEA: Invite local Premier League followers into an MLS experience without treating their overseas attachment as a mistake. Learn which local experiences add something they value.

BASIS: Community identity and fan networks frame meaningful local connections.

OBJECTIVE: Understand why local soccer followers do or do not consider the MLS club part of their identity.

KPI: Opt-in newcomer participation, reported relevance and repeat interest, separated by existing club affiliations.

TEST: Compare a proximity-led invitation with a community-led invitation using comparable groups and the same offer. Ask why each message resonated.

CAUTION: A campaign response is not proof of a change in identity. Dual fandom is a legitimate outcome.

SOURCES
R02: https://doi.org/10.1123/jsm.21.3.319
R03: https://www.mdpi.com/1660-4601/18/14/7351
R10: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.smr.2017.06.004
See the website evidence library for links and limitations.
